subject.title: fix(heartbeat): bound HEARTBEAT.md file read size

question: Should an oversized `HEARTBEAT.md` silently disable its instructions for that run, or should OpenClaw warn the operator while keeping heartbeat scheduling alive?
rationale: The size cap is technically sound, but silent task suppression changes established behavior and the repository evidence does not establish that this user experience is intentional.

options.title: Warn and continue
options.body: Skip oversized content, keep the runner alive, and emit an operator-visible diagnostic so suppressed heartbeat tasks are discoverable.

options.title: Silently treat as missing
options.body: Accept the PR’s current behavior and explicitly own the compatibility risk that oversized heartbeat instructions disappear without notice.

recommendation.title: Warn and continue
recommendation.body: Skip oversized content, keep the runner alive, and emit an operator-visible diagnostic so suppressed heartbeat tasks are discoverable.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest recent history signal for review and merger decisions in `src/infra/heartbeat-runner.ts`.
